text: Most gun homicides in the United States are gang related.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.source: KFF Health Misinformation Tracking Poll Pilot
room.questionWording: Most gun homicides in the U.S. are gang related
room.note: 9% definitely true, 33% probably true, 37% probably false, 19% definitely false; sums to 101 because of rounding.

truthSource.label: National Gang Center (U.S. Dept. of Justice)
truthSource.oneLine: Federal data put gang-related killings at roughly one in eight U.S. homicides, far from a majority.

lesson.tip: A vivid image can stand in for a number. Ask for the actual share and who counted it.
